LESSON: MIDDLE DISTANCE RACES AND MONTAGE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.3: Middle Distance Races and Montage

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Middle Distance Races and Montage
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do running techniques affect performance in middle distance races?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe middle distance races in athletics
2. perform middle distance races for skill acquisition
3. discuss characteristics of a montage composition
4. create a montage composition inspired by athletes running
5. describe methods of creating a melody
6. compose a 2-bar answering phrase to a given 2-bar opening phrase
7. compose a 4-bar melody in G major
8. perform simple pieces of music in G major
